finding.headline: "The Omugwo Closet Reset"
finding.problem: "Every morning I stand in front of the wardrobe and cry. Nothing fits the body I have now. I feel like a stranger in my own skin and I'm ashamed to even leave the bedroom."
finding.person: A 32-yr-old Naija mum in diaspora (London), 5 weeks post C-section, belly still swollen, none of her pre-pregnancy clothes zip, and her mum (visiting for omugwo) keeps saying "you used to be fine."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (combines body-confidence + wardrobe transition).". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
